content:
Simple & Fast CMS Without Database

AICMS is a file-based content management system with a built-in AI assistant, powerful Lumina editor and multilingual support. Everything runs on JSON files — no MySQL, no complex setup.

📄

No Database

Content stored in JSON files. Moving a site is as simple as copying a folder.

✨

AI Assistant

Generate text, images and video right in the editor. Multiple AI providers supported.

🌍

Multilingual

Build sites in multiple languages. AI-powered page translation in one click.

🎨

Themes & Modules

7 ready-made themes, template builder, 10+ configurable modules with settings.

AICMS Features

📝 Lumina Editor

Full-featured WYSIWYG editor with formatting, tables, images, video, block templates, AI content generation and shortcode system.

🔧 Modules

10+ ready-made modules: contact form, booking, comments with ratings, mini-shop, mini-forum, countdown timer, CTA banner and more. All with settings.

👥 Management

Pages, news, media library, menu, modules, themes, backups, trash, versioning, audit log, global search.

🛡️ Security

Brute force protection, CSRF tokens, recycle bin for deleted items, page versioning, action audit log.

📖 Documentation ⚡ Features

title: About AICMS
meta_title: About AICMS — File-based CMS with AI
meta_description: AICMS — file-based CMS without database with built-in AI assistant, Lumina editor and module support.
content:
About AICMS

AICMS (AI Content Management System) is a modern file-based content management system designed for those who want to build a website quickly and without complex configuration. Unlike traditional CMS that require MySQL, AICMS stores all content in JSON files, making installation and site migration as simple as possible.

Architecture

AICMS is built on a simple but reliable architecture: a PHP core processes requests, reads content from JSON files and renders it through the theme template engine. For interactive modules (comments, shop, forum), MySQL or SQLite can be used — but this is optional, basic operation does not require a database.

Key architectural principles:

  • File-based storage — pages, news, settings in JSON. Backup = copy a folder.
  • Template engine — themes use simple syntax: {{page_content}}, {{foreach:pages as p}}.
  • Modular system — shortcodes {{module:name}} inserted into any content.
  • Hybrid mode — JSON for content, MySQL/SQLite for interactive features.

History

AICMS was created as an alternative to heavy CMS for small and medium websites. The main goal is to give users a powerful tool without the need to configure a database server, but with the ability to connect a DB when truly needed. The built-in AI assistant and Lumina editor make content creation fast and enjoyable.

Technologies

  • PHP 7.4+ — server-side
  • JSON — primary data storage
  • MySQL / SQLite — optional, for interactive modules
  • Lumina Editor — custom WYSIWYG editor built on vanilla JS (ES Modules), no external frameworks
  • Bootstrap 5 — admin panel and themes
  • Monaco Editor — code editor for modules and templates
  • Font Awesome 6 / Bootstrap Icons — icons
  • Chart.js — dashboard charts

title: Features
meta_description: Complete list of AICMS features: Lumina editor, AI assistant, modules, themes, multilingual, caching and more.
content:
AICMS Features

📝 Lumina Editor

Lumina Editor is a full-featured WYSIWYG editor built into AICMS. It provides all the tools for creating professional content:

  • Text formatting: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript/subscript
  • Headings H1-H4, quotes, lists, checklists
  • Text and background colors, fonts, sizes, line height
  • Tables with row and column management
  • Images: upload, by URL, drag-and-drop, resize, rotate
  • Video: YouTube, Vimeo, direct links
  • Block templates: hero sections, team cards, pricing, FAQ, accordions
  • Toggle buttons "Read more / Collapse" for hiding content
  • Source code mode with syntax highlighting
  • Fullscreen mode, preview, auto-save
  • Undo/Redo with change history
  • Sticky toolbar
  • Module shortcodes directly in the editor

✨ AI Assistant

The built-in AI assistant supports generating three types of content:

  • Text — articles, descriptions, news. 8 prompt templates. Providers: OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq, Z.ai.
  • Images — generate images from description. Providers: Pollinations (free!), Z.ai, Stability AI, OpenRouter (DALL-E 3).
  • Video — generate video from description. Providers: Z.ai (CogVideoX), Stability Video.

Additionally: AI-generated SEO meta tags, AI page translation to other languages.

🌍 Multilingual

AICMS supports unlimited languages:

  • Each language — separate localization file in admin/locales/
  • Russian, English, German, Spanish — built-in
  • Add new languages via admin panel (based on template)
  • Translation coverage percentage for each language
  • AI page translation in one click
  • Language switcher in admin sidebar

🎨 Themes

7 ready-made themes + template builder:

  • Helios — transparent navbar, lightbox, animations
  • Default — simple Bootstrap template
  • Modern — sticky navbar, clean design
  • Aurora — gradient hero, glassmorphism, back-to-top button
  • Editorial — magazine layout, serif typography, sidebar
  • Tech — dark theme, neon accents, animated background
  • Minimal — ultra-minimalism, single column, slide-down menu

Template builder: 3 layouts × 6 color schemes × 5 fonts = 90 combinations.

🔧 Modules

13 configurable modules with settings:

  • Contact form (email, fields, messages)
  • Contact info card (address, phone, email, hours)
  • Features grid (icons, titles, descriptions)
  • CTA banner (title, text, button, colors, style)
  • Social links (8 platforms, style, size)
  • Countdown timer (date, format, colors)
  • Example module (settings demo)
  • Latest news feed (count, date, preview)
  • News accordion (date format, behavior)
  • Booking form (date, time, guests, contacts)
  • Comments with ratings (stars, replies, moderation)
  • Mini-shop (catalog, cart, orders, categories)
  • Mini-forum (topics, posts, categories)

Shortcodes with parameters: {{module:contact_form|email=admin@x.com}}

Widget zones in themes: {{zone:sidebar}} — modules in global zones.

🛡️ Security & Management

  • Page caching (HTML cache with TTL)
  • Recycle bin for pages and news (restore)
  • Page versioning (up to 10 versions, rollback)
  • Audit log (log of all admin actions)
  • Login rate limiting (brute force protection)
  • Drafts and scheduled publishing
  • Global content search
  • SEO: Open Graph, sitemap.xml, meta tags
  • .htaccess management from admin (toggles + manual editor)
  • Database management from admin (MySQL/SQLite connection)

title: Documentation
meta_description: Complete AICMS guide: hosting install, content creation, modules, themes, AI assistant.
content:
AICMS Documentation

The complete step-by-step guide: from uploading to hosting to creating content, modules and themes.

📦 1. Requirements & Hosting Upload

Requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or higher (8.0+ recommended)
  • PHP extensions: json, session (required); mbstring, pdo, curl, zip (recommended)
  • Web server: Apache, Nginx, or the built-in PHP server
  • Optional: MySQL or SQLite for modules (comments, shop, forum)

Step 1. Upload to Hosting

  1. Download the aicms-release.zip release archive.
  2. In your hosting panel (cPanel, ISPmanager, DirectAdmin) open the File Manager.
  3. Upload the archive to the site root (public_html or www) and extract it.
  4. Alternatively, extract locally and upload via FTP (FileZilla).

Step 2. Folder Permissions

chmod -R 755 aicms/
chmod -R 775 aicms/data aicms/uploads aicms/admin/cache

🛠️ 2. Installation

Open https://your-site.ru/install.php — a 5-step installation wizard:

  1. Choose language — English or Russian.
  2. Requirements check — PHP version and extensions.
  3. Storage — JSON (no DB) or MySQL/SQLite.
  4. Site settings — name, theme, default language.
  5. Administrator — login and password for the admin panel.

After installation, be sure to delete install.php. Admin panel: https://your-site.ru/admin/.

📝 3. Creating Content

Pages

Pages are the primary content unit. Each page has:

  • Title — shown in navigation and on the page
  • Slug — page URL (e.g. ?page=about)
  • Content — HTML edited in the Lumina editor
  • Template — individual theme for the page (optional)
  • Status — Published / Draft / Scheduled
  • SEO — Meta Title and Meta Description

News

News items are similar to pages but have a publish date and are rendered by widgets:

{{module:latest_news}}   — latest news feed
{{module:news_list}}     — accordion of all news

Lumina Editor

Lumina is the built-in WYSIWYG editor: text formatting, tables, images, video, block templates, AI generation, module shortcodes, auto-save, source code mode.

🔧 4. Modules

A module is a PHP file in the modules/ folder. Create my_module.php:

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../admin/core/module_settings.php';
$s = module_get_settings('my_module', ['title' => 'Hello World!', 'color' => '#2563eb']);
?>
<div style="color:<?= $s['color'] ?>">
    <h3><?= $s['title'] ?></h3>
</div>

Usage in content: {{module:my_module}} or with params {{module:my_module|title=My Title|color=#ff0000}}.

13 ready-made modules

Contact form, contact info card, features grid, CTA banner, social links, countdown timer, latest news, news accordion, booking, comments with ratings, mini-shop, mini-forum, example module.

🎨 5. Themes & Template Builder

A theme is a folder in themes/ with index.html and style.css. Template engine syntax:

{{site_title}}      — site title
{{page_title}}      — page title
{{page_content}}    — page content
{{foreach:pages as p}}
  <a href="?page={{p.slug}}">{{p.title}}</a>
{{endforeach}}
{{if:p.slug == current_slug}}active{{endif}}
{{zone:sidebar}}    — widget zone

In admin: Themes → Generate — 3 layouts × 6 color schemes × 5 fonts = 90 combinations. 7 ready-made themes: Helios, Default, Editorial, Tech, Minimal and more.

🌍 6. Multilingual

  • Each language — a separate localization file in admin/locales/
  • Russian, English, German, Spanish — built-in
  • Add new languages via the admin panel
  • AI page translation in one click

✨ 7. AI Assistant

  • Text — 8 prompt templates. Providers: OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq, Z.ai
  • Images — Pollinations (free!), Z.ai, Stability AI
  • Video — Z.ai (CogVideoX), Stability Video
  • AI-SEO meta tags, AI page translation

Configuration: Settings → AI Networks.

🗄️ 8. Database

Core content is stored in JSON. A database (MySQL/SQLite) is optional — for comments, shop and forum. Setup: Settings → Database. Tables are created automatically.

🛡️ 9. Security & Maintenance

  • Cache — HTML page cache with 1-hour TTL, cleared on save
  • Recycle bin — deleted pages and news can be restored
  • Versioning — up to 10 versions of each page with rollback
  • Audit log — log of all admin actions
  • Rate limiting — 5 failed logins → 15-minute IP block
  • Backups — "Backups" section, auto-backup on first admin visit

📋 10. Folder Structure

aicms/
├── admin/            Admin panel
│   ├── assets/       CSS, JS, Lumina Editor
│   ├── core/         Core (functions, db, cache, lang…)
│   ├── locales/      Localization (ru, en, de, es…)
├── data/             Site data
│   ├── config.json   Settings
│   ├── content/      Content per language
│   │   ├── ru/pages.json, news.json
│   │   └── en/pages.json, news.json
│   ├── trash/        Recycle bin
│   └── versions/     Page versions
├── modules/          Modules (PHP)
├── themes/           Themes
├── uploads/          Uploaded files
├── index.php         Frontend
├── install.php       Installer
└── sitemap.php       Sitemap.xml generator
